fixes.change: Remove the official logo at top-right of FactoryStage; retain only the required header and opening-story placements, at native aspect.
Add bidirectional highlight: focusing ev-cert-qty/ev-recv-qty in inspector highlights the 120 vs 80 tracks and RECEIVING node, and vice versa.
Make inspector internally scrollable with a visible end-of-evidence marker so content below the fold at 768px is discoverable by keyboard.
Visually and semantically separate the ROUTE HEALTH·PRE-FLIGHT nonce/identity check (status-only fieldset) from the distinct investigation route/task controls below it.
Give the route select a persistent label, focus ring, and aria-describedby tying 'offline · no network request' to the Sample choice.
Reduce duplicated status copy to one sentence above the primary; keep DecisionBar as the sole primary action.
On selecting a recovery option, keep the typed consent form open in-place with the exact APPROVE phrase, character count and disabled-until-exact Accept clearly associated via aria-describedby.
Make the three option cards a radiogroup with arrow-key navigation and a neon+text Selected state, not colour alone.
Align option-card finish/cost columns tabularly so 83h/$0.00, 35h/$3,115.00 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 scan vertically.
Keep t1-t3 explicitly labelled PROPOSED·UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL with untracked icon+text; do not assign tracked styling before Approve.
Show 40+30=70 and MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts on the accepted route in the SVG with a feasible/accepted marker matching the legend.
Move Decline proposal adjacent to Approve in DecisionBar focus order while keeping only Approve as the single neon primary.
Keep pre-application CELL-MILL-2 as PREVIEW only: silver dashed outline plus PREVIEW-not applied text; reserve stoppedRed cross-hatch for after Apply.
Announce the consequence in DecisionBar centre: 'Applying invalidates prior acceptance' and require the select change before enabling Apply second shock.
Remove or keyboard-enable Scenario management as a real button; do not leave it as inert text.
Render stopped CELL-MILL-2 with stoppedRed outline/cross-hatch, OFFLINE text and no route through it; update legend state accordingly.
As Step 2, keep pre-flight nonce/identity route-health separate from the reinvestigation task and primary.
In the SVG mark Split as CONSTRAINED with marker+text and reduce feasible paths from 3 to 2 consistently in banner, inspector and stage.
Retain typed consent for revised acceptance, visually distinct from Step 3 by the 'Scenario changed·review required' status and invalidated-prior-acceptance notice in DecisionBar.
Disable the CONSTRAINED Split card as a radio option with explanatory text, excluded from arrow-key selection.
Keep exact-phrase input, remaining count and disabled Accept state until exact match; surface errors via aria-live=polite only on submit attempt.
Show coexisting states explicitly side-by-side: Prior tracked 3 BLOCKED (expandable) and Revised proposal 3 UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL, while noting the approved recovery plan remains accepted.
Keep stoppedRed only on CELL-MILL-2; accepted revised route must bypass it and terminate at JOB-1001/JOB-1002.
Make the Prior tracked work disclosure a 40px button with aria-expanded and keyboard focus visible.
Separate Seal encrypted packet, Verify ledger and Export independent checkpoint into three labelled steps with independent completion states; DecisionBar primary must match the next incomplete step.
Constrain inspector to internal scroll at 768px and pin the passphrase field label, 16-160 guidance and strength status without page scroll.
Add pattern+text to tracked-task summary (3 tracked·0 done·0 blocked) and link it to the SVG event chain.
Replace generic completion primary with a single Review recovery proof action and add completion state to StepRail with check+text, not colour alone.
Masked passphrase field should be read-only on completion with custody warning retained; do not imply strength guarantees custody.
Summarise sealed state in DecisionBar centre (PACKET SEALED·18 events·revised plan accepted) and ensure it is reachable in the defined tab order.
